subject.title: Add github-copilot as media-understanding image provider

question: Should GitHub Copilot become an automatic media-understanding image provider, or remain an explicit-model-only image path?
rationale: Current main can execute explicit Copilot image models, but automatic media-understanding eligibility changes provider routing, auth expectations, rate-limit behavior, and fallback selection.

options.title: Approve provider-owned auto eligibility
options.body: Add `contracts.mediaUnderstandingProviders` and media metadata in the GitHub Copilot plugin, with focused fallback-order tests, docs, and live Copilot image proof.

options.title: Hold for provider-owner review
options.body: Leave this issue open until a provider owner confirms the Copilot auth/rate-limit policy and desired fallback priority.

options.title: Keep explicit-only and close
options.body: Document `agents.defaults.imageModel` or explicit `openclaw infer image` Copilot usage as the supported path and do not add Copilot to automatic media-understanding fallback selection.

recommendation.title: Hold for provider-owner review
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a provider owner confirms the Copilot auth/rate-limit policy and desired fallback priority.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most recent merged Copilot image-runtime fix and live proof path inspected here.
